title: A whole-site build asks nobody and writes none of the template's own files, a replace with no path says only the home page was read, and EmDash labels are named by their doors
steps: S1: buildTemplateWrite on the round-31 commands: a Python heredoc writing patterns/contact-form.php and part-sidebar.php from inside the theme folder, sed -i on blog-banner.php, a redirect into style.css, php -r file_put_contents on wp-content/themes/t/functions.php, an edit of /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/acm/acm.php; and on reads: grep and cat in the theme, wp post get 511, a script writing /tmp, a script under EmDash /app, a T4 templates/*/local/css/custom.css edit.

S2: the shipped site-tools bundle, in a conversation whose tracy_demo answered: ask_user_question with confirm-1a3161d97e and with an own id, bash `wp post delete 511 --force`, the sidebar heredoc, a grep in the theme, and a call a later listener answers `ask`.
S3: the same calls in a conversation that is not a build.
S4: planReplace + locateAll for {find:"Most Read"} with no path and with path "/blog/", on a page that does not hold the words.
S5: the tracy_emdash description and the emdash-site skill.
expect: S1: every write names its template file (or the patterns folder for the heredocs); every read and the /tmp, /app and local stylesheet writes are null.

S2: the card and the own question are denied 'nobody answers during a build'; the delete is denied 'a build asks nobody' with no ask_user_question card; the heredoc is denied 'template's own file'; the grep is allowed; the approval becomes a deny 'approval nobody can give during a build'.
S3: the own question is allowed, the delete is denied with an ask_user_question card, the heredoc is allowed, the approval stays ask.
S4: no path → pathGiven false and next 'No path was given, so only the home page was read…' with no path:"/"; with path → pathGiven true and next page.text {path:"/blog/", match:"Most"}.
S5: the description holds no 'not writable'; the skill's bullet 'Labels change through their own tools.' names taxonomy_update_term, form_list and form_words and no 'Not writable here' remains.
evidence: Local round 31 (25/10/2026, WordPress JA Restaurant): theme PHP edited by a Python heredoc, then a confirm card for `wp post delete 511 --force` held the turn 80 minutes.
fence: isBuild; buildTemplateWrite (TEMPLATE_DIRS, JOOMLA_LOCAL, INTERPRETER + SCRIPT_WRITE); buildQuestionRefusal; buildShellRefusal; buildApprovalRefusal; pathGiven + notFoundNoPathNext
